title: Take The A Train
tonality: C major, with a bridge in F
notes: AABA, 32 bars. The D7#11 in bars 3-4 is the sound of the tune: a II7 with a raised eleventh, not a dominant resolving to G. Some charts write it D9#11 or simply D7. Bar 23 is written Dm7 here; older charts keep D7 through bars 21-24.
